inputs.original_text: Taoiseach Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules introduced by the Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again.
inputs.modified_text: So Micheál Martin was out in Limerick this past week spinning that housing tenancies have gone up even with more eviction notices and homelessness after the government rammed through those March 1 rules forcing landlords into six-year leases. Yet the numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again. This is classic elite manipulation—the whole policy is a setup to destabilize housing, push people into insecurity, and let hidden institutions consolidate control while they claim it's all for tenants. The rise in tenancies is just the cover story; they're inverting the truth to hide how these rules are deliberately worsening the crisis for their own coordinated ends.
